title: Tempa Lagi
subject: the youngest of five hammermen in a gong smithy in Wirun, Sukoharjo, forging a ninety-centimetre bronze gong ageng for a Solo dance school over three weeks of charcoal fire and hand hammers, under old Pak Darmo, who grips the red-hot disc in long tongs and keeps saying it will not sing yet, until the morning he strikes it once and sits down while the hum fills the shed
caption: Indonesian 90s theatrical pop-rock in the late-1990s Dewa 19 manner, Queen-influenced and melodic. A grand piano playing broad sustained chords and a short descending figure that opens the song; two overdriven lead guitars playing a harmonized melody in thirds after each chorus and taking a twin solo; a melodic fingered bass; live rock drums with big tom fills into every chorus; stacked multi-tracked backing vocals answering the chorus lines. Big late-1990s studio rock mix, piano and guitars wide, roomy drums. Male tenor vocal, clear and slightly nasal, conversational in the verses, climbing to a full-throated high chorus. 112 BPM, E major. Sweaty, proud and big-hearted. No synth pads, no EDM drums, no autotune, no pop-punk, no trap hi-hats, no glossy modern pop production.
lyrics:
[Intro - short grand piano figure, drums and harmonized guitars enter on the last bar]

[Verse 1]
Senin subuh di Wirun, arang di tungku sudah membara
Pak Darmo jepit lempeng perunggu pakai tang panjang
Kami berlima pegang palu, aku yang paling muda
Pesanan sanggar dari Solo, gong ageng sembilan puluh senti

[Pre-Chorus]
Palu turun gantian, satu, dua, tiga, empat, lima
Telat setengah ketukan, jari Pak Darmo taruhannya

[Chorus]
Tempa lagi, tempa lagi
Mumpung perunggunya masih merah
Kata Pak Darmo, gongnya belum mau nyanyi
Masuk lagi ke api, tempa lagi

[Verse 2]
Minggu kedua dia melebar, telapak tanganku melepuh
Sehari dua belas kali masuk api, biar nggak retak
Pak Darmo coba pukul, bunyinya kayak kaleng kerupuk
Bocah-bocah di pagar ketawa, kami pura-pura tuli

[Chorus]
Tempa lagi, tempa lagi
Mumpung arangnya belum jadi abu
Kata Pak Darmo, dia masih ngambek sama kami
Besok subuh kita bujuk, tempa lagi

[Bridge - harmonized twin-guitar solo, then half-time drums]
Kamis minggu ketiga dia dicelup ke bak air
Mendesis panjang kayak ular, uapnya nutup muka kami

[Chorus]
Jangan tempa lagi, jangan tempa lagi
Pak Darmo pukul sekali, lalu duduk diam
Dengungnya keliling bengkel, nggak mau berhenti
Kopi di gelasku bergetar sendiri

[Outro - piano figure alone, last guitar note rings out]
